title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
authors: H. Touvron, L. Martin, K. Stone, et al.
before: The best open weights were research-only, so companies could not build on them.
problem: Open models were a research curiosity rather than a commercial option.
breakthrough: Open weights with a commercial licence, a documented RLHF pipeline, and chat models tuned for safety.
why: It made open weights a viable business decision and set off serious enterprise adoption.
next: Code Llama, Llama 3 and 3.1, then the pivot away from open releases in 2026.
inherits: The community licence model, restrictions and all.
